name: scene3d_patch_settings
description: Merge scene-wide settings fields. Allowed: prompt, styleMode, customStylePrompt, cinematicSettings, cinematicModifierKeys, ground. Use ground to recolour, hide or raise the scene floor that every world already has — never add a plane object as a floor, it lands on top of the built-in one and the two z-fight. activeCameraId/viewerCamera/cameraPath are forbidden: the viewport camera is the user's and no tool writes it; edit the camera path with the scene3d_*_keyframes tools. @see guides_get('scene3d')

ground.description: The scene floor. Every world already has one; adjust it instead of adding a floor object.

gridVisible.description: Whether the metric grid is drawn on the floor.

heightMeters.description: Floor height in metres above the scene floor, between -10 and 10. Out-of-range values are clamped.
